description: One-call profile of any Hyperliquid wallet: account value, every open perp position (side, size, entry, liquidation price, leverage, unrealized PnL), spot balances and its realized trading record (PnL, win rate, trade count, volume, human score). Use this first for questions like "what is this wallet holding?" or "is this trader any good?". Set includeHip3=true to include HIP-3 markets such as xyz:TSLA.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

includeHip3.description: Also include positions on HIP-3 markets (stocks, indices, commodities). Default false.

name: hydromancer_wallet_overview
title: Wallet overview: balance, open positions, PnL record
